category_title: Students with IDD in Task Learning Classes (SAT) focused on autonomy and adult life skills
scenario_title: Vocational skills practice and peer interaction in Task Learning Class
minimal_context: The student is preparing to practice using gardening materials in a cooperative learning group with peers from the ordinary class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Today we are going to practice using the gardening materials. You will be doing this in a cooperative learning group with students from the ordinary class.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I’m learning a lot, to use materials. Gardening, carpentry... I like all.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: That is good. Please go over to their table and start working together.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: In primary education I was happy with my teachers and classmates. In secondary education, it was hard at the beginning, you need to adapt.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just go join them and see what they are doing.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I did not get along well with some people in the ordinary class.

task.content: Learning to use materials (gardening, carpentry) and reviewing subjects from earlier years
task.learning_goal: Develop their autonomy and skills for adult life as fundamental purposes of their individual educational programme

context.environment: Task Learning Class (SAT) and ordinary class environments
context.materials: Materials for gardening, carpentry, sewing, and the canteen
context.social_setting: Cooperative learning and peer support settings

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: During the transition to secondary education when adapting to new environments and ordinary classes
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Did not get along well with some people in the ordinary class
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Finding it hard at the beginning, feeling the need to adapt
related_quotes: In primary education I was happy with my teachers, classmates, games, studies and excursions. In secondary education, it was hard at the beginning, you need to adapt. Now I’m very happy with the teachers, and also with the classmates. Despite, I did not get along well with some people in the ordinary class.

behavior_patterns.condition: When peer support appears to happen naturally, not planned
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Did not get along well with some people in the ordinary class
related_quotes: Despite, I did not get along well with some people in the ordinary class.
